# Canine
Canines are Vulpkanin in everything but the face. Same build, same reflexes, same short temper about cold weather.
Where a Vulpkanin's muzzle is part of the face they were born with, a Canine's is not: pick the snout you want in character setup and change it whenever you like. Everything else - ears, tail, markings, the Canilunzt they grew up speaking - is Vulpkanin.
